name: Dustdevil
lore: An enchanted brass vacuum from the town workshops. No stray spark escapes its spotless patrol.

primary.name: Intake
primary.description: Hold primary for a close intake: 12 damage every 0.7 seconds and a 1-second slow. Within the first 0.4 seconds it can catch one hostile projectile. Release to fire it where you aim for 36–60 damage. Stored shots release automatically after 6 seconds.

secondary.name: Brush Crush
secondary.description: Swing the brush across a close 110-degree arc, dealing 38 damage within 100 units.

special.name: Grand Draw
special.description: Channel a visible 320-unit vacuum cone for 2.5 seconds, pulling enemies towards the nozzle for a follow-up Brush Crush. Walls stop pulling; bosses are pulled less.

passive: Overload: every 6 seconds, release a 145-radius poison pulse. Nearby enemies take 3 poison damage per second for 4 seconds.

technique.name: Broad Brush
technique.description: Brush Crush reaches 35% farther, with 20% less damage.

final_technique.name: Dustbag Detonation
final_technique.description: Three delayed dustbags deal 22 plus mild poison. Gives up the large vacuum pull; enemies must be predicted rather than gathered.

attack.name: Dustbag Detonation
attack.description: Three delayed dustbags deal 22 plus mild poison. Gives up the large vacuum pull; enemies must be predicted rather than gathered.
